questions.label: Sinusoid Check
questions.text: Where's your energy today: top, middle, or bottom of the wave?
questions.help: Top = full load possible. Middle = moderate, one main thing. Bottom = protection mode, DO NOW + habits only.

questions.label: Boardroom Check
questions.text: Quick stats, 1-10 each: Health, Friends, Fun, Work/Money?
questions.help: Any director at 4 or below gets a small maintenance session scheduled this week.

questions.label: Brain Dump
questions.text: Dump everything on your mind: tasks, worries, ideas, fires. No filtering.
questions.help: Get it out of RAM. Everything.

questions.label: Goal Anchor
questions.text: What's the ONE outcome that makes today a win? Just one.
questions.help: This becomes the filter for everything else.

step_8_evaluation.description: End of day ruthless reading — 4 questions

questions.label: Quality of Work
questions.text: Rate the quality of today's work (1-10). What was the best thing you shipped?

questions.label: Progress Made
questions.text: What needle actually moved today? Be specific: file created, ad uploaded, skill learned.

questions.label: Time Wasted
questions.text: Where did you leak time? Social media? Overthinking? Distractions? Be honest.

questions.label: Focus Level
questions.text: Were you present during deep work, or was your mind elsewhere? (1-10)

step_8_evaluation.closing_quote: You yourself said that if you don't push yourself to do what's required, you will remain the same idiot with bad body, big mouth, and nothing to show for it. And you will hate yourself forever.
